name: JDC Duo
description: A matching pair of watch charging docks that keeps your watches in one place and your desk clear.
summary: Keep two watch chargers together on your IKEA SKÅDIS pegboard.
image_alt: Printed JDC Duo docks mounted on a pegboard with a Pixel Watch and Galaxy Watch
subtitle: Watch charging docks for your pegboard
highlights: Fits the original Pixel Watch 3 (45 mm) and Galaxy Watch4 (44 mm) charging pucks.
Mounts on an IKEA SKÅDIS pegboard.
Side openings let you place your watch in the dock with its bracelet closed.

details.title: Compatibility
details.text: Made for the original charging pucks supplied with the Pixel Watch 3 (45 mm) and Galaxy Watch4 (44 mm), on an IKEA SKÅDIS pegboard. Other watches and charger revisions have not been checked.

details.title: What is included
details.text: A complete PLA pair: two dock bodies and two removable charger inserts. Watches, original charging pucks, cables and the pegboard shown in the photos are not included.

details.title: Delivery
details.text: £1.99 UK delivery per order. Made to order. Dispatch within 2–3 working days; delivery transit time is additional.

details.title: Current status
details.text: The PLA prototype has been printed and fitted to the creator’s board. The Pixel insert fitted, and the revised Galaxy insert held its charger in a physical fit check. Long term charging, heat, load and durability checks are still in progress.

independent_note: Independent design. Not an IKEA, Google or Samsung product.
dispatch_note: Made to order. Dispatch within 2–3 working days; delivery transit time is additional.
